newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares hit new highs but rally seen easing.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares hit new highs but rally seen easing.

text.p: The bullish trend on the Oslo bourse appeared to continue on Monday with the Total share index crossing a fresh all-time high despite domestic players taking a back seat ahead of third-quarter financial results.
Dealers said the market trend would remain weakly to the upside with stable interest rates and firm oil prices providing some support in an otherwise lacklustre market.
The Total share index almost 0.5 percent up at 877.67 points after hitting a high 878.02 points. Turnover was a moderate 573 million crowns.
"There's talk of interest rates maybe coming down which is giving some support and people are looking at the blue chips with a fresh eye," said one broker.

"But local actors are not very active at the moment. They're watching rates and the budget negotiations. There are also more (corporate) results due out this week so people will probably play close to their chests until those figures arrive."

Business was spread across the board, industrial heavyweight Norsk Hydro being the most traded stock in value terms at a drab 42.7 million crowns. The share slipped 0.50 crowns to 310.50 crowns. --Oslo newsroom, +47 22 42 50 41
